application_credentials.description: MyDashLight signs in to Google with your own OAuth client. Follow the [setup instructions]({more_info_url}): set up the [sign-in screen]({oauth_consent_url}), then [create an OAuth client]({oauth_creds_url}) of type **Web application** and paste its client ID and secret here.

parents.title: The parents who drive
parents.description: MyDashLight plans the kids' rides for two parents. Enter the name to show for each. You can change these later.

data_description.mom_name: The name shown on the ride board, such as Robin.
data_description.dad_name: The name shown on the ride board, such as Sam.

calendars.title: Pick the calendars
calendars.description:
Signed in as {account}. MyDashLight plans rides for the activities on each kid's calendar. Events on a parent's busy calendars mean that parent can't drive then. Calendars you don't pick are never read.

The first parent is {mom} and the second is {dad}.

data_description.kids: One calendar per kid, holding the activities that need rides.
data_description.mom_calendars: Optional. Events marked Free, and events this parent declined, don't count.
data_description.dad_calendars: Optional. Events marked Free, and events this parent declined, don't count.

kid_name.title: Kid {number} of {count}
kid_name.description: The name shown on the ride board for the calendar {calendar}.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Google again
reauth_confirm.description: Google no longer accepts MyDashLight's sign-in for {account}. Sign in again with the same account.

error.names_match: The two parents need different names.
error.kids_required: Pick at least one kid's calendar.
error.kid_calendar_as_busy: A kid's calendar can't also be a parent's busy calendar.
error.shared_busy_calendar: Pick each busy calendar for one parent only. A calendar both parents use belongs to neither.
error.kid_names_match: Two kids can't have the same name.

abort.already_configured: This Google account is already set up.
abort.already_in_progress: MyDashLight setup is already open in another window.
abort.api_disabled: The Google Calendar API is turned off in your Google Cloud project. Turn it on, then try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Google Calendar. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: Google turned down the sign-in. Try again.
abort.no_primary_calendar: This Google account has no main calendar, so MyDashLight can't tell which account it is.
abort.wrong_account: That's a different Google account. Sign in with {account} instead, or remove MyDashLight and set it up again.
abort.missing_credentials: Add your Google OAuth client first, under Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials.
abort.missing_configuration: Add your Google OAuth client first, under Settings > Devices & services > Application credentials.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out while making the Google sign-in link.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL to send Google back to. Set one under Settings > System > Network. [More help]({docs_url})
abort.oauth_error: Google sent back a sign-in that can't be used.
abort.oauth_timeout: Timed out while finishing the Google sign-in.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The Google OAuth client isn't available right now.
abort.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. The Home Assistant log has the details.

planner.name: Planner timing

data_description.arrive_early: When an event has no Arrive by time, aim to get there this long before it starts.
data_description.go_home_margin: Drive home between stops when that frees at least this much more time than waiting.
data_description.take_along_window: With take-along on, kids whose drop-offs are this close together leave home together.
data_description.waiting_after: Reaching a pick-up later than this after it ends counts as the kid waiting.
data_description.too_early: Getting there more than this long before the target is flagged.
data_description.tight_slack: Less spare time than this before the next stop is flagged.
data_description.no_address_travel: The drive time used for an event with no location.
